question: How should Metal optimization coding data be formatted and built to teach useful reasoning and improve output quality?
conclusion: Prefer executable, evidence-grounded tasks matched to the intended agent interface. Combine complete historical edits with explicit diagnostic decision examples now; collect actual successful tool-feedback trajectories as a separately qualified extension. No universal best ratio or edit syntax is established by these sources.

sources.finding: Execution environments and test-validated tasks support collecting successful agent trajectories. Their experiments support diversity of repositories and task types; repeated easy solutions were capped.
sources.scope_limit: Software repair in Python; not evidence that our final-layer Metal adapter improves.

sources.finding: Pairs real repository tasks with executable environments and unit tests; trains agents and outcome verifiers from trajectories.
sources.scope_limit: A verifier or successful training fit is not an independent proof of numerical correctness.

sources.finding: Backtranslates commits into task statements using failing tests and execution information, reducing vague prompts relative to changes alone.
sources.scope_limit: Backtranslated statements need leakage review: future solution details must not appear as observed pre-change evidence.

sources.finding: Documents code-data cleaning, instruction synthesis, staged SFT, and decontamination against evaluation entry points and n-gram overlap.
sources.scope_limit: Its large-model/pretraining recipe is not a measured optimum for this small specialized LoRA corpus; generic code overlap needs review, not indiscriminate deletion.

sources.finding: Conversational tool datasets carry messages, tool_calls, tool-role observations and tools schemas. Assistant-only supervision requires correct template masking; completion-only is a separate supported mode.
sources.scope_limit: TRL documentation describes TRL, not capabilities automatically present in our MLX trainer.

sources.finding: CUDA kernel optimization is trained as iterative generation with execution feedback. Authors report benefits of multi-turn RL and identify reward hacking and difficulty imbalance.
sources.scope_limit: Their RL outcome does not establish that adding prose reasoning to our SFT will reproduce the gain.

sources.finding: Measures generated kernels jointly by correctness and speed, including the fraction correct above a speed threshold.
sources.scope_limit: CUDA benchmark results do not transfer to Apple hardware; correct-and-fast needs local measurement.

sources.finding: Current evaluation notes identify reference-result reuse, mutated inputs and timing/stream tricks; include adversarial tests for the harness.
sources.scope_limit: Mutable documentation inspected 2026-10-13; design guidance rather than an endorsement of any generated kernel.

sources.finding: Authors report that stronger hidden input distributions and realistic accelerated baselines reduce apparent speedups, and include memory tradeoffs.
sources.scope_limit: Paper findings are author-reported CUDA experiments; Apple adaptation requires its own baseline, timing and numerical gates.

format_contract.storage: Standard JSONL messages/tools for model input; separate hash-bound provenance and validation records. Preserve original source and observed logs independently of rendered teaching text.
task_input: Complete relevant baseline source plus required host/build context
Hardware, shapes, strides/layout, dtype and dispatch constraints actually known
Observed failure or measured baseline, with units and provenance
Allowed edit/tool schema and acceptance tests
assistant_target: Concise evidence-based diagnosis, explicitly distinguishing observation from hypothesis
Mechanism and why it addresses the stated regime
Complete replayable edit using the actual deployed agent tool
Validation interpretation and remaining uncertainty only when supported by observed results
format_contract.no_answer_leakage: For prospective edit/diagnosis tasks, keep post-change source, exact solution hint and achieved speed out of the prompt. Retrospective evidence-interpretation tasks may include them but are labeled separately and cannot count as optimization discovery.
format_contract.reasoning: Teach useful decisions, not length: evidence -> hypothesis -> mechanism -> applicability -> discriminating test. Do not synthesize profiler counters, measurements, author intent or tool observations. Curator inferences are labeled and source-linked.
format_contract.deployment_match: Do not claim unified diff, SEARCH/REPLACE or apply_patch is universally best. Pick the serving agent interface, serialize with the exact tokenizer template, validate function names/schema/control tokens, and replay the edit.
format_contract.loss: Supervise intended assistant actions and explanations; exclude prompts and observed tool output from targets. Check exact token boundaries and EOS. Raw JSON validity alone is insufficient.
format_contract.length: Measure after chat/tool serialization. Keep complete edits. Explicitly exclude over-capacity cases; no silent truncation or conversion of fragments into supposedly complete tasks.

curriculum.purpose: Reproduce a concrete optimization or correctness repair from sufficient baseline context
curriculum.gate: Pinned source/parent, license, complete host/build dependencies, replay and independent review; report local compile/numerical/performance status separately

curriculum.purpose: Choose a bottleneck hypothesis, explain a boundary failure, select a discriminating experiment, or reject an unsupported speed claim
curriculum.gate: Source-grounded answer, explicit inference labels, no fabricated observations; count linked source families once

curriculum.purpose: Use an actual compiler error, numerical mismatch or timing regression to revise a kernel
curriculum.gate: Observed tool logs plus successful independent final verification; current runtime does not support native tool-observation training

curriculum.purpose: Learn when an optimization is invalid or harmful
curriculum.gate: Rejected code is never a positive SFT answer. Keep chosen/rejected pairs separate; current trainer does not implement DPO/RL

curriculum.purpose: Ask for the missing shape/layout/profile or recommend a test when the evidence cannot justify a change
curriculum.gate: Concrete missing fact and actionable test, not generic caution

quality_gates: Deduplicate before split by exact payload, patch, commit and known port/cherry-pick lineage; review semantic near duplicates across engines without assuming different engines are duplicates.
Freeze held-out task families before creating alternate explanations, repairs or counterexamples; all derived views inherit split.
Count unique changes/families separately from serialized views and repeated training exposures.
Report coverage by operation, mechanism, hardware, dtype, shape regime, correctness/performance evidence, repository and difficulty; more paraphrases do not fill missing mechanisms.
Replay complete edits and validate source identities; compilation requires actual includes/macros/template instantiations and dispatch contracts.
Numerical tests include tails, degenerate sizes, layouts, extreme values and dtype-specific tolerances; compare with an independent reference and negative controls.

Performance requires matched hardware/workload/precision, warmup, synchronization, repeated timing and memory measurement; reject input mutation/reference reuse and hidden work outside the timed region.
Evaluate generated actions under equal token/tool budgets and count parse/compile/runtime failures. NLL remains diagnostic, not a claim of better kernels.
Report per-task regressions and paired uncertainty; bootstrap by independent task family rather than treating correlated tokens as independent samples.

current_implementation_audit.supported: Plain chat final-answer supervision and exactly one terminal native function call; loss_start masks a contiguous final target.
current_implementation_audit.unsupported: tool_data.py rejects tool-role observations and nonterminal tool calls. Arbitrary multi-turn agent trajectories, assistant span masks across tool outputs, DPO and RL are not provided.
current_implementation_audit.immediate_action: Keep this run on reviewed complete exact edits plus bounded positive diagnostics. Do not pretend reconstructed history is a recorded agent trajectory or change pinned runtime during training.
current_implementation_audit.extension: Add separate versioned multi-turn ingestion and assistant-span masking with tokenizer/replay tests, then collect actual measured repair rollouts. Per-turn views require complete prior context and shared lineage/weighting; they are not independent tasks.

next_run_application.mix: Use existing exact core and a declared <=20% diagnostic-row heuristic; report both token share and update share. This ratio is not a literature-established optimum.
next_run_application.split: Preserve prior 16 held-out examples and protected generated probes; no scoring-based selection.
next_run_application.claims: Two expression probes and five rationale tokens cannot establish broad reasoning or optimization quality. Report these as narrow checks; add a separate frozen diagnostic evaluation before generation and a richer executable suite later.
next_run_application.training_comparison: A larger set plus more updates tests the whole recipe. Isolating data quality requires matched-budget ablations; do not attribute all change to reasoning data.

adversarial_questions: Can the answer be copied from the prompt or commit message without reading code?
Does the rationale invent a bottleneck that was never measured?
Does every declared speedup identify hardware, workload, precision and source?
Is the edit replayable but uncompilable because required host/build changes were omitted?
Do ports or explanation variants leak across splits or inflate independent example counts?
Can a zero-output, input-mutating or hardcoded kernel pass our tests?
Does averaging per-example losses overweight short diagnostic prose?
Can the current serving agent actually parse and execute the trained action format?
Are we claiming reasoning gains from serialization loss or a saturated two-question evaluation?
